### 1. Business Context & Stakeholder Requirement
- **Requesting Team:** Risk Analytics / Operations
- **Business Need:** What business decision or SLA does this requirement support?

### 2. Functional Requirements
- Input specifications and ingestion frequencies.
- Outlier and validation tolerances.

### 3. Engineering Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Schema invariants verified
- [ ] Unit & integration tests added
- [ ] Linting & code review completed
